purpose: Test the shifted-timestamp video-lookup consequence left open by phase 2 for r1:c1:f0, and the same query class for r71:c1:f1. r94:c1:f1 is an epoch-scale comparator. No detector, threshold, severity, score or published output is changed by this experiment.

offset_selection.basis: LeRobotDataset defaults to delta_timestamps=None, which queries only the current timestamp, so no dataset default determines shifted offsets. Training derives them in datasets/factory.py::resolve_delta_timestamps from the policy config's observation_delta_indices. Rule, fixed before any probe: include every policy configuration shipped in the tested release whose default observation_delta_indices is not None, at its dataclass defaults, plus one no-delta control covering the configs that return None. plan.py rescans policies/*/configuration_*.py and refuses to plan if the set differs.
offset_selection.nominal_basis: The phase-2 remaining-gap text named raw timestamp + k/30. LeRobot 0.3.3/0.4.0 __getitem__ does not construct such queries (it reads stored row timestamps), so this class is a labeled comparator only. k ranges over the nonzero offsets of the configs above.
offset_selection.limits: Defaults only. Non-default n_obs_steps/horizon, custom delta_timestamps, action/reward keys (which do not touch video), and policies outside these releases are not covered.

anchor_rule: first=0, middle=len//2, worst_grid=argmax(|diff(stored timestamps) - 1/fps|) (first maximum; the same rule as phase-2 decode_fineart.py), last=len-1. Rows are episode-relative.

decoder.primary: lerobot.datasets.video_utils.decode_video_frames(path, queries, tolerance_s=1e-4, backend='pyav'), the pyav path phase 2 used
decoder.default_backend_attempt: get_safe_default_codec() returns 'torchcodec' whenever the module spec exists. One decode_video_frames(..., backend=None) attempt per case is recorded. If torchcodec cannot load, that path is unresolved (dependency failure), not passed.
decoder.returned_timestamps: decode_video_frames returns frames only. probe.py records returned frame pts from an independent replay of the same torchvision VideoReader window (seek(min, keyframes_only=True), read until pts >= max). It asserts that the replayed frames are tensor-equal to the upstream output and that the replayed pass/fail equals the upstream outcome. A mismatch is reported as a harness discrepancy and the batch counts as unresolved.

decision_rules.buckets: loader_derived/in_range, loader_derived/padded, nominal_grid/in_range and nominal_grid/outside_episode are evaluated separately and never pooled.
decision_rules.bucket_verdict: supports_claim if any batch raises the decoder tolerance AssertionError; contradicts_claim if every batch ran and decoded within tolerance; unresolved if any batch had a non-tolerance error or did not run (and none hit tolerance); not_applicable if empty.
decision_rules.case_scope: A case conclusion names its query class, loader release, backend and episode. Direct-decoder results never establish full-loader or training behavior. A full-loader construction failure observed in phase 2 keeps the full-loader consequence unresolved.
decision_rules.identity: Any input hash or revision mismatch, or upstream source hash mismatch, stops that case: no probe runs and the case stays unresolved.

cases.full_loader_status_from_phase2: LeRobotDataset construction fails in 0.4.0 and 0.5.1 on source dtype 'language' (evidence/r1_c1_f0_loader_0.4.0.json, evidence/r1_c1_f0_loader_0.5.1.json). Not bypassed here.
cases.prediction_from_source_reading: Written before probes, not a decision criterion. Rows and videos are both about 90 Hz while info.json declares fps=30, and from_timestamp is 0.0. Loader-derived queries are stored row timestamps, so they are expected to land on video frames and decode. Nominal raw+k/30 equals raw+3k/90, so it is also expected to decode when in range. Separately, a delta index of 1 spans about 1/90 s, not the 1/30 s the config intends.

cases.full_loader_status_from_phase2: LeRobotDataset construction raises KeyError('stats') in episode metadata (evidence/r71_c1_f1_loader.json). Not bypassed here.
cases.prediction_from_source_reading: Written before probes, not a decision criterion. Rows start at 0.7333 s on a 1/15 s grid and the video pts start at 0.0, so loader-derived queries are expected to decode in range. Whether the decoded frame is the physically matching image is not testable from timestamps.

cases.full_loader_status_from_phase2: LeRobotDataset construction raises ValueError from check_timestamps_sync (evidence/r94_c1_f1_loader.json), so __getitem__ is never reached in 0.3.3.
cases.reuse: Existing local inputs recovered in phase 2 are reused after hash verification, with no new download. Phase-2 raw-timestamp failures (12/12) remain the comparator baseline.
cases.prediction_from_source_reading: Written before probes, not a decision criterion. Epoch-scale queries (about 1.784e9 s, float32-rounded) against video pts 0 to 14.5 s are expected to fail tolerance in every bucket.

scope_limits: One episode per case; other listed episodes are not probed.
pyav backend only; the default torchcodec backend is attempted and recorded, not substituted.
Direct decoder calls with loader-derived query sets; LeRobotDataset is not constructed or patched.
No training, policy checkpoint, or image-content alignment check.
